description:
Grammar sweep: traps (EXIT, ERR, DEBUG, RETURN and the catchable signals), their scoping,
listing and interaction with errexit, functions and subshells (see sweep_grammar_param.py).

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at end of script
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at exit 3
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; echo body; exit 3

cases.name: gram trap exit exit in handler at exit 3
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; exit 9' EXIT; echo body; exit 3

cases.name: gram trap exit failing handler at exit 3
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; false' EXIT; echo body; exit 3

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at failing last command
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; echo body; false

cases.name: gram trap exit reads a variable at failing last command
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "v=$v"' EXIT; echo body; false

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at errexit
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; set -e; echo body; false; echo not

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at nounset
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; set -u; echo body; echo $undefined_zz; echo not

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at error operator
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; echo body; : ${u_zz?gone}; echo not

cases.name: gram trap exit reads a variable at error operator
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "v=$v"' EXIT; echo body; : ${u_zz?gone}; echo not

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at exit in a function
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; f() { exit 4; }; f

cases.name: gram trap exit exit in handler at exit in a function
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; exit 9' EXIT; f() { exit 4; }; f

cases.name: gram trap exit failing handler at exit in a function
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; false' EXIT; f() { exit 4; }; f

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at kill TERM to self
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; kill -TERM $$; echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit reads a variable at kill TERM to self
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "v=$v"' EXIT; kill -TERM $$; echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at return at top level
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; return 2; echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit echo at exec builtin
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo "exit trap status=$?"' EXIT; exec true

cases.name: gram trap exit exit in handler at exec builtin
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; exit 9' EXIT; exec true

cases.name: gram trap exit failing handler at exec builtin
cases.script: v=set; trap 'echo handler; false' EXIT; exec true

cases.name: gram trap exit numeric zero
cases.script: trap 'echo zero' 0; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit SIGEXIT name
cases.script: trap 'echo sigexit' SIGEXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit lower case name
cases.script: trap 'echo lower' exit; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit reset with dash
cases.script: trap 'echo never' EXIT; trap - EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit ignore with empty string
cases.script: trap '' EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit replaced
cases.script: trap 'echo first' EXIT; trap 'echo second' EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit in a subshell runs at subshell end
cases.script: ( trap 'echo sub-exit' EXIT; echo in-sub ); echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit not inherited by a subshell
cases.script: trap 'echo main-exit' EXIT; ( echo in-sub ); echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit in a command substitution
cases.script: x=$(trap 'echo cs-exit' EXIT; echo in); echo "[$x]"

cases.name: gram trap exit in a function stays global
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo from-f' EXIT; }; f; echo after-f

cases.name: gram trap exit in a pipeline stage
cases.script: trap 'echo pipe-exit' EXIT | cat; echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit handler output order
cases.script: trap 'echo handler' EXIT; echo body; echo err >&2

cases.name: gram trap exit handler sees the exit status
cases.script: trap 'echo "status=$?"' EXIT; (exit 5); exit

cases.name: gram trap exit handler changes status only with exit
cases.script: trap 'false' EXIT; true

cases.name: gram trap exit handler with a here-document
cases.script:
trap 'cat <<EOF
from trap
EOF' EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit handler defines and calls a function
cases.script: trap 'g() { echo g; }; g' EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit handler with multiple commands
cases.script: trap 'echo a; echo b' EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit handler with quotes
cases.script: trap "echo 'single' \"double\"" EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit handler expands late
cases.script: v=early; trap 'echo $v' EXIT; v=late

cases.name: gram trap exit handler expands early with double quotes
cases.script: v=early; trap "echo $v" EXIT; v=late

cases.name: gram trap exit handler invoking exit trap again
cases.script: trap 'echo once; exit 2' EXIT; exit 1

cases.name: gram trap exit trap -p EXIT
cases.script: trap 'echo it'\''s' EXIT; trap -p EXIT; trap - EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit trap -p all
cases.script: trap 'echo e' EXIT; trap 'echo r' RETURN; trap -p; trap - EXIT RETURN

cases.name: gram trap exit trap with no arguments lists
cases.script: trap 'echo x' EXIT; trap; trap - EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit trap -p of an unset trap
cases.script: trap -p EXIT; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap exit trap -p of an ignored signal
cases.script: trap '' TERM; trap -p TERM

cases.name: gram trap exit trap -- form
cases.script: trap -- 'echo dashdash' EXIT

cases.name: gram trap exit trap with one argument resets
cases.script: trap 'echo x' EXIT; trap EXIT; trap -p EXIT; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram trap exit trap with a numeric first argument resets
cases.script: trap 'echo x' EXIT; trap 0; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit invalid signal name
cases.script: trap 'echo x' NOSUCH; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram trap exit invalid signal number
cases.script: trap 'echo x' 999; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram trap exit missing handler
cases.script: trap; echo status=$?; trap -x; echo status=$?

cases.name: gram trap exit several signals at once
cases.script: trap 'echo multi' EXIT TERM; trap -p TERM; trap - TERM

cases.name: gram trap exit exit trap and errexit inside handler
cases.script: set -e; trap 'false; echo still-in-handler' EXIT; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit exit trap after a syntax error in eval
cases.script: trap 'echo exit-trap' EXIT; eval 'if'; echo after

cases.name: gram trap exit exit trap with set -u error in handler
cases.script: trap 'echo $undefined_zz; echo not' EXIT; set -u; echo body

cases.name: gram trap exit exit trap and background job
cases.script: trap 'echo exit-trap' EXIT; { echo bg; } & wait

cases.name: gram trap exit exit trap in a sourced file
cases.script: printf "trap 'echo src-exit' EXIT\n" > /tmp/t.sh; . /tmp/t.sh; echo body

cases.name: gram trap err at simple command
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at and list head
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; false && true; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at and list tail
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; true && false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at or list
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; false || false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at negated
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; ! true; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at if condition
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; if false; then :; fi; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at while condition
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; while false; do :; done; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at pipeline
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; true | false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at subshell
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; (false); echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at group
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; { false; }; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at function
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; f; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at function with errtrace
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; set -E; f; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at command substitution
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; x=$(false); echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at command substitution with errtrace
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; set -E; x=$(false); echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at arithmetic
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; (( 0 )); echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at conditional
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; [[ -z x ]]; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at command not found
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; nosuchcmd_zz 2>/dev/null; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at failed redirect
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; echo > /tmp/no/x 2>/dev/null; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at return nonzero
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; g; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err at pipefail
cases.script: f() { false; echo in-f; }; g() { return 3; }; trap 'echo "ERR status=$? line=$LINENO"' ERR; set -o pipefail; false | true; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err with errexit
cases.script: set -e; trap 'echo err-trap' ERR; false; echo not

cases.name: gram trap err reset
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; trap - ERR; false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err not inherited by a function without -E
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; f() { false; echo in-f; }; f; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err inherited with set -o errtrace
cases.script: set -o errtrace; trap 'echo err' ERR; f() { false; }; f

cases.name: gram trap err handler failing does not recurse
cases.script: trap 'echo err; false' ERR; false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err BASH_COMMAND in handler
cases.script: trap 'echo "cmd=$BASH_COMMAND"' ERR; false

cases.name: gram trap err in a subshell
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; ( false; echo in-sub )

cases.name: gram trap err set in a function
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo f-err' ERR; }; f; false; echo after

cases.name: gram trap err loop body
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; for i in 1 2; do false; done

cases.name: gram trap err case body
cases.script: trap 'echo err' ERR; case x in x) false;; esac

cases.name: gram trap err trap -p ERR
cases.script: trap 'echo e' ERR; trap -p ERR

cases.name: gram trap debug counts simple commands
cases.script: n=0; trap '((n++))' DEBUG; echo a; echo b; trap - DEBUG; echo "n=$n"

cases.name: gram trap debug BASH_COMMAND
cases.script: trap 'echo "> $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; echo one; x=2; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug before compound commands
cases.script: trap 'echo "> $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; for i in 1; do :; done; if true; then :; fi; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug before arithmetic and conditional
cases.script: trap 'echo "> $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; (( 1 )); [[ x ]]; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug not inherited by functions
cases.script: f() { echo in-f; }; trap 'echo dbg' DEBUG; f; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug inherited with functrace
cases.script: set -T; f() { echo in-f; }; trap 'echo "dbg $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; f; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug in a subshell
cases.script: trap 'echo dbg' DEBUG; ( echo sub ); trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug in a pipeline
cases.script: trap 'echo "dbg $BASH_COMMAND"' DEBUG; echo p | cat; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug handler status
cases.script: trap 'false' DEBUG; echo still-runs; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug LINENO in handler
cases.script:
trap 'echo "line $LINENO"' DEBUG
echo a
echo b
trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug trap -p DEBUG
cases.script: trap 'echo d' DEBUG; trap -p DEBUG; trap - DEBUG

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN after a function
cases.script: trap 'echo "return from ${FUNCNAME[0]-main}"' RETURN; f() { echo in-f; }; f

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN not inherited without functrace
cases.script: f() { echo in-f; }; trap 'echo ret' RETURN; f; echo after

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN with functrace
cases.script: set -T; trap 'echo ret' RETURN; f() { echo in-f; }; f

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN after source
cases.script: echo 'echo sourced' > /tmp/r.sh; trap 'echo ret-src' RETURN; . /tmp/r.sh

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN status
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo "ret $?"' RETURN; return 4; }; f; echo "after $?"

cases.name: gram trap debug RETURN set inside the function persists
cases.script: f() { trap 'echo ret-f' RETURN; }; g() { :; }; f; g; echo after

cases.name: gram trap signal caught TERM via kill default
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught TERM"' TERM; kill $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default TERM via kill default
cases.script: kill $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored TERM via kill default
cases.script: trap '' TERM; kill $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught TERM via kill -s
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught TERM"' TERM; kill -s TERM $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default TERM via kill -s
cases.script: kill -s TERM $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored TERM via kill -s
cases.script: trap '' TERM; kill -s TERM $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught TERM via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught TERM"' TERM; kill -TERM $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default TERM via kill -SIG
cases.script: kill -TERM $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored TERM via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap '' TERM; kill -TERM $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught TERM via kill -n
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught TERM"' TERM; kill -n 15 $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default TERM via kill -n
cases.script: kill -n 15 $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored TERM via kill -n
cases.script: trap '' TERM; kill -n 15 $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught INT via kill -s
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught INT"' INT; kill -s INT $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default INT via kill -s
cases.script: kill -s INT $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored INT via kill -s
cases.script: trap '' INT; kill -s INT $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught INT via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught INT"' INT; kill -INT $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default INT via kill -SIG
cases.script: kill -INT $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored INT via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap '' INT; kill -INT $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught INT via kill -n
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught INT"' INT; kill -n 2 $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default INT via kill -n
cases.script: kill -n 2 $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored INT via kill -n
cases.script: trap '' INT; kill -n 2 $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught HUP via kill -s
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught HUP"' HUP; kill -s HUP $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default HUP via kill -s
cases.script: kill -s HUP $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored HUP via kill -s
cases.script: trap '' HUP; kill -s HUP $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught HUP via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught HUP"' HUP; kill -HUP $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default HUP via kill -SIG
cases.script: kill -HUP $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored HUP via kill -SIG
cases.script: trap '' HUP; kill -HUP $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught HUP via kill -n
cases.script: trap 'echo "caught HUP"' HUP; kill -n 1 $$; echo "after status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default HUP via kill -n
cases.script: kill -n 1 $$; echo not-reached

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored HUP via kill -n
cases.script: trap '' HUP; kill -n 1 $$; echo "survived status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal spec SIGTERM
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler SIGTERM"' SIGTERM; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - SIGTERM

cases.name: gram trap signal spec 15
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler 15"' 15; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - 15

cases.name: gram trap signal spec sigterm
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler sigterm"' sigterm; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - sigterm

cases.name: gram trap signal spec SIGINT
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler SIGINT"' SIGINT; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - SIGINT

cases.name: gram trap signal spec 2
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler 2"' 2; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - 2

cases.name: gram trap signal spec 1
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler 1"' 1; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - 1

cases.name: gram trap signal spec SIGHUP
cases.script: trap 'echo "handler SIGHUP"' SIGHUP; trap -p | while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done; trap - SIGHUP

cases.name: gram trap signal caught in a subshell
cases.script: ( trap 'echo sub-caught' TERM; kill -TERM $BASHPID; echo sub-after ); echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal default in a subshell
cases.script: ( kill -TERM $BASHPID; echo not ); echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal handler exits
cases.script: trap 'echo bye; exit 7' TERM; kill $$; echo not

cases.name: gram trap signal ignored inherited by a subshell
cases.script: trap '' TERM; ( kill -TERM $BASHPID; echo sub-survived ); echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal caught is reset in a subshell
cases.script: trap 'echo main' TERM; ( kill -TERM $BASHPID; echo not ); echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal trap -p in a subshell shows caught traps
cases.script: trap 'echo main' TERM; ( trap -p TERM ); trap - TERM

cases.name: gram trap signal trap -p in a command substitution
cases.script: trap 'echo main' TERM; x=$(trap -p TERM); echo "[$x]"; trap - TERM

cases.name: gram trap signal kill -0 self
cases.script: kill -0 $$; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal kill with a bad signal
cases.script: kill -s NOSUCH $$; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal kill with no arguments
cases.script: kill; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: gram trap signal kill -l numbers
cases.script: kill -l 1 2 15 9; kill -l 130

cases.name: gram trap signal kill a background job with TERM
cases.script: { sleep 5 & p=$!; kill -TERM $p; wait $p; echo "status=$?"; } 2>/dev/null

cases.name: gram trap signal kill a background job with a trap inside
cases.script: { ( trap 'echo job-caught; exit 3' TERM; : > /tmp/ready; sleep 5 & wait ) & p=$!; until [[ -f /tmp/ready ]]; do sleep 0.01; done; kill -TERM $p; wait $p; echo "status=$?"; } 2>/dev/null

expected.reason: fixture: a call ends with its jobs, so the sleep a subshell left running is stopped and reported when the call ends (README, background jobs), where bash leaves it running unreported

cases.name: gram trap signal signal and EXIT trap order
cases.script: trap 'echo exit-trap' EXIT; trap 'echo term-trap' TERM; kill $$; echo after

cases.name: gram trap signal signal during a loop
cases.script: trap 'echo caught; stop=1' TERM; stop=0; for i in 1 2 3; do (( i == 2 )) && kill $$; (( stop )) && break; echo $i; done

cases.name: gram trap signal USR1 trap
cases.script: trap 'echo usr1' USR1; kill -USR1 $$; echo after

cases.name: gram trap signal CHLD trap
cases.script: trap 'echo chld' CHLD; true & wait; trap - CHLD; echo done
